description: Aree di rispetto dei depuratori (Art.23 POC riferito al territorio dell'ex Comune di Tavarnelle Val di Pesa) - Comune di Barberino Tavarnelle is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.055055.it. The areas in which the existing or planned municipal purifiers, identified in the 1/10,000 scale cartography, insist, are surrounded by 100 ml compliance bands. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Areas of respect for purifiers (Art.23 POC referring to the territory of the former Municipality of Tavarnelle Val di Pe" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Piano Operativo, depuratori, vincoli, pianificazione, fasce di rispetto, geodata. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
